<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def winfo():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    W=[n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color']=='W' and n['pixels']>20][0]
    b=W['boundary']; wr=(min(p[0] for p in b),max(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b),max(p[1] for p in b))
    # reds near white (within 12 of white center)
    wc=( (wr[0]+wr[1])//2, (wr[2]+wr[3])//2 )
    reds=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='R':
            c=((min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])+max(p[0] for p in n['boundary']))//2,(min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])+max(p[1] for p in n['boundary']))//2)
            if abs(c[0]-wc[0])<14 and abs(c[1]-wc[1])<14:
                reds.append((min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])))
    reds.sort()
    return wr,reds
print('state0',winfo())
for k in range(3):
    action(['SPACE'])
    print('after SPACE',k+1,winfo(),'step',current_frame.step)

def winfo():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    W=[n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color']=='W' and n['pixels']>20][0]
    b=W['boundary']; wr=(min(p[0] for p in b),max(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b),max(p[1] for p in b))
    # reds near white (within 12 of white center)
    wc=( (wr[0]+wr[1])//2, (wr[2]+wr[3])//2 )
    reds=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='R':
            c=((min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])+max(p[0] for p in n['boundary']))//2,(min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])+max(p[1] for p in n['boundary']))//2)
            if abs(c[0]-wc[0])<14 and abs(c[1]-wc[1])<14:
                reds.append((min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])))
    reds.sort()
    return wr,reds
